zh-CN.title: 打字机与小票拥有完整设计语言
items: 未来界面系列正式下架，终端、全息和机械气泡会迁移到更成熟的保留款式
打字机加入纸张错位、色带油墨、机械压痕和编号标记，并为双方设计不同纸张
小票加入热敏纸齿边、流水号、分隔线与条码，所有消息卡片都遵循同一票据结构

en.title: Typewriter and Receipt now speak complete design languages
items: The Future Interface collection has been retired, migrating Terminal, Hologram, and Mechanical to stronger retained designs
Typewriter now combines offset paper, ribbon ink, mechanical impressions, serial marks, and distinct sheets for both sides
Receipt now uses perforated thermal stock, serial lines, separators, and barcodes across every message card type
